time: built by build-packet.py from the copied raw wall-clock.jsonl files
note: Exact surviving reaction rows from all five testers and ten sessions, kept literally, not a reconstructed producer diary. Every raw reaction is kept, including ones the report omits, shortens or respells, and ones with an escaped or dropped apostrophe. Rows with no reaction text (opens, automatic shots, some waits) are counted in rows but not listed. Failed driver taps keep their error text in the raw copy. reactionsNotLiterallyInReport counts reactions whose exact text is not a substring of that tester's report.md. containsBackslash flags a reaction that holds a literal backslash. Report memories and estimates stay separate; a report line is not substituted for a raw row.

input.name: Call Nerys Ask how high the river is.

reactions.reaction: Warn Mill Lane is a hold button here. I did not see that on the phone. Good that warning needs a hold, so I cannot do it by accident. I just call Nerys.
Nerys again says hello after her report, word for word like the phone. Here it starts to feel like the same script, not a new evening.
Weir 0.43 of 1.6. Low, I guess, but nothing tells me what is a lot. River at step 1. I open the gate to 3 like on the phone.

Monday on the big screen was good, I caught two wrong readings myself. But Tuesday is the same form again: same note from M, same Nerys hello, set gate, ask level, skip, wait. I have now done this four nights in total tonight across two devices. I know the shape. Enough for this evening.

I pressed I am stopping and Back took me to the menu. I stop here. The Monday night on the computer with Fast pace and the lightning picture was the best part of my evening. Tuesday felt like the same evening again, and I do not want to repeat the same form.
